notes_for_editor: Only listing evidence: a Forest Lookouts page with the name and county, and a Florida fire-tower list entry (26.40694, -81.41694, Collier). Record coordinates are within about 40 m of the list. The record's status is unknown and no source here says whether the tower stood or stands now. No build date, design, staffing, access or photo was found. The 1932 statewide count (source 4) is background only and does not name this tower. Budget: 2 web searches, about 5 page reads.
